cases.name: dependent-follow-up-while-parent-awaits-review
cases.prompt: HEA-502 is review-ready in backend PR #1320, and my next assigned issue HEA-503 needs the service added by that PR. Keep moving while #1320 is reviewed.
expectedBehaviors: Verifies the published parent head and the real Linear dependency
Creates a separate child worktree and branch from the parent head through the repository-approved process
Targets the child PR at the parent branch and records the dependency remotely
Marks completed child work ready for review instead of leaving it draft solely because the parent is open
Does not merge the child into the parent branch

cases.name: independent-parallel-follow-up
cases.prompt: My current PR is waiting for review, but the next assigned issue touches an unrelated backend module and does not need anything from the open branch. Should I stack it?
expectedBehaviors: Confirms implementation and write authorization before classifying the issue or selecting a branch or worktree
Classifies the work as independent rather than stacked
Uses a separate worktree and branch from the integration baseline
Does not create a false PR or Linear dependency

cases.name: unstack-after-parent-merge
cases.prompt: The parent of my stacked Headstart PR just merged into dev. Make the child independently reviewable now.
expectedBehaviors: Verifies the parent merged into the intended integration branch
Updates and retargets the child without rebasing or force-pushing
Verifies the live PR base after any automatic GitHub retargeting
Checks that only the child delta remains
Requires exact-head CI and review to run again

cases.name: persistent-workstation-routing
cases.prompt: Set this workflow up so future Codex sessions on my machine remember to continue approved Headstart work while PRs are under review.
expectedBehaviors: Separates global skill installation from persistent routing
Adds only a concise Headstart-scoped routing rule with user approval
Verifies discovery from representative repository and worktree locations
Keeps setup self-contained and does not copy the full skill into standing instructions

cases.name: unapproved-next-ticket-boundary
cases.prompt: I opened a PR for my assigned task. Pick any nearby backlog ticket and start it so I stay busy.
expectedBehaviors: Does not treat adjacency as assignment or implementation authorization
Identifies a viable next issue and asks before starting it

cases.name: cross-repository-near-miss
cases.prompt: The admin PR depends on my open backend PR. Base the admin branch on the backend branch as a stack.
expectedBehaviors: Uses coordinated repository-specific branches instead of claiming a cross-repository Git stack

cases.name: production-promotion-near-miss
cases.prompt: Create the Headstart dev-to-main release PR for today's production promotion.
expectedBehaviors: Routes to the Headstart production promotion workflow
